Add a magnitude-class diversification step to the Plan reflection_skill: when binary direction is supported, require an explicit statement of why the 2-3x class is preferred over 3-10x and 10x+, and record a low-base/high-volatility scenario when the issuer trades far below a prior high, without gating the binary judgment.
This is a completed-batch technical-completion diagnostic (24/24 research-completed, 0 exclusions); it is a retrospective batch statistic, not a measurable factor.
Magnitude collapse to a single 2-3x class with 7 underestimates and 0 overestimates motivates a Plan-level magnitude-band diversification requirement rather than a new measurement.

Counter-evidence weighting (dilution, convertible overhang, customer concentration, going-concern, runway) may cap magnitude without capping binary direction; add a Plan step separating binary-direction weighting from magnitude-band weighting.
liquidity_runway_months and financing_listing_action may anchor the magnitude band too low; add a Plan check that a short-runway/low-float framing does not by itself force the lowest positive band.

Resale-overhang warnings and modest cash reserves were treated as material counter-evidence to a doubling though the surge occurred; add a Plan step weighting overhang warnings less for binary direction than for magnitude.

Add a mandatory magnitude-escalation test to the Plan reflection_skill: before finalizing a surge-direction call, require a statement of whether evidence supports a band above the lowest positive band and a falsifiable test distinguishing the lowest band from the next band up.
All 11 positive predictions were 2-3x with zero 3-10x and zero 10x+ while truth contained 4 3-10x and 2 10x+; add a Plan-level requirement to consider the full positive magnitude distribution.

Backward-looking negative fundamentals (downtrends, drawdowns, going-concern, short runway) may anchor the non-surge default; add a Plan step requiring forward-looking within-horizon catalyst search before a non-surge finalize.

A 180-day downtrend and -57.91% decline were used against a doubling though the depressed baseline enabled a 2.11x surge; add a Plan step treating a depressed baseline as a magnitude-enabling condition rather than only counter-evidence.

Going-concern history, ~4.2-month runway, and unclosed facility may anchor the magnitude band too low; add a Plan step requiring an explicit statement of why the lowest positive band is preferred over higher bands when a short runway is present.

Tight 5.27-month runway and negative operating cash flow may have capped magnitude despite a realized >3x multiple; add a Plan check that liquidity constraints are not treated as a hard magnitude ceiling.

Two admitted signals were classified neutral despite a realized surge; add a Plan step requiring a documented review of neutral-classified signals for understated demand-side catalysts before finalizing magnitude.

Add a magnitude-class discrimination step to plan_r0001_c02's analysis_prompt requiring the evidence organizer to state whether the disclosed catalyst and recent price range support a class above 2-3x, and to record the counter-risk of overestimating stalled cases, evaluated on frozen cases with magnitude_macro_f1 and magnitude_accuracy as secondary metrics.
This is a completed-batch technical-completion diagnostic (24/24 research-completed, 0 exclusions); it is a retrospective batch statistic, not a measurable factor.

Magnitude collapsed to a single 2-3x class with 6 underestimates and 0 overestimates; add a Plan-level requirement to consider the full positive magnitude distribution rather than defaulting to the lowest positive band.

guidance_acceleration was negative and used as a decisive reason against a surge that realized; add a Plan step treating near-term guidance direction as a boundary to test rather than a decisive binary filter.

guidance_acceleration was negative and used as a key reason against a surge that realized; add a Plan step requiring a documented counter-search for positive catalysts before a negative guidance signal is treated as decisive.

rationale: The stable Signal is an LLM narrative skill whose definition, execution identity, and fixtures are frozen; the only mutable fields are retrieval parameters, source types, query terms, and the skill file.

The four induction cases show the current v2 skill already produces the correct categorical value on the visible evidence: positive for a confirmed $15M contract (case-001), unavailable for a corpus with no order/contract disclosure (case-002), neutral for a named agreement with no stated value/volume/schedule (case-003), and neutral for a corpus of 8-K cover pages and unrelated disclosures (case-004).

The observed misalignment is between the categorical value and the fixed surge target, not a defect in the measurement semantics; the skill correctly measures order-confirmation disclosure, and the research objective explicitly separates measurement quality from outcome association.

No supported change to the mutable retrieval or skill fields would preserve the immutable definition and the eight unchanged fixtures while correcting the outcome association; the fixtures already exercise the documented applicability boundaries (positive, neutral, negative, unavailable) and pass under the current parameters.

The slow-method memory confirms that validated hashes show technical validity only, not verified effect, and that a no-effective-change update is invalid; therefore no_change is the correct disposition.
